headline: Bitstamp Intake Rises To 290.5 Million Dollars From 235.8 Million
narrative: Bitstamp clean-asset intake rose to 290.5 million dollars from 235.8 million, so more dollar value is arriving on that venue than on the prior reading. A positive pipe is dollars arriving on the venue, sell-side supply, and a negative pipe is dollars leaving, measured as the 24-hour change in holdings excluding each exchange's own token. Binance intake eased to 553.6 million dollars from 562.3 million, while intake across 79 exchanges stands at 944.6 million dollars, 0.3491 percent of the 270.6 billion dollars held on those venues.
author: jordan
